newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks edge lower in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks edge lower in London trading.

text.p: Hong Kong shares dropped in London trading on Wednesday, reflecting early losses in U.S. Treasury bonds and a mixed opening on Wall Street, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index closed down 34.39 points at 12,741.08, backtracking from the Hang Seng's 2.2 percent surge in the territory earlier today to a record close of 12,775.47.
Yet as the Dow shook off its initial caution to be up almost one percent by late morning, traders said the Hang Seng could push further into record territory after yesterday's all-time peaks.

"We've been having some good U.S. economic numbers and we've had the right election result so I think it will follow through in Hong Kong," said a trader at one major securities house here. "But at 13,000 I think it will peter out."
